The '''Manari system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Brevost sector/Legends|Brevost sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Manari]], where a [[Battle of Manari|battle]] was fought in [[19 BBY/Legends|19.5 BBY]], during the final months of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
